newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-HOUGHTON RECALLED FOR ROMANIA GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOUGHTON RECALLED FOR ROMANIA GAME.

text.p: Crystal Palace's veteran midfielder Ray Houghton was named on Wednesday in the 23-man Republic of Ireland squad for the World Cup group eight qualifer against Romania on April 30.
Houghton, 35, won the last of his 67 caps for Ireland in the 5-0 drubbing of Liechtenstein in Eschen last August.
Goalkeepers: Alan Kelly (Sheffield United), Shay Given (Blackburn Rovers).

Defenders: Denis Irwin (Manchester United), Kenny Cunningham (Wimbledon), Gary Kelly (Leeds United), Gary Breen (Coventry City), Curtis Fleming (Middlesbrough), Jeff Kenna (Blackburn Rovers), Terry Phelan (Everton), Richard Dunne (Everton).
Midfielders: Ray Houghton (Crystal Palace), Alan Moore (Middlesbrough), Roy Keane (Manchester United), Steve Staunton (Aston Villa), Dave Savage (Millwall).
Strikers: David Kelly (Sunderland), Keith O'Neill (Norwich City), David Connolly (Watford), Jon Goodman (Wimbledon), Tony Cascarino (Marseille), Mark Kennedy (Liverpool).
